summary: Upgrade automation dashboard from versions before 0.1: copy the old inventory into the new bundle, add a [redis] group and redis_mode=standalone, run ansible.containerized_installer.dashboard_install, then add refresh_token, client_id and client_secret to clusters.yaml.
questions: How do I upgrade automation dashboard?
What Redis settings does the automation dashboard upgrade need?
Which fields must I add to clusters.yaml when upgrading automation dashboard?

answer_card.title: Upgrade automation dashboard (add Redis)
answer_card.answer_md:
In the new bundle's `inventory`:
```ini
[redis]
host.example.com ansible_connection=local

[all:vars]
redis_mode=standalone
```
Then run:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml
ansible-playbook -i inventory ansible.containerized_installer.dashboard_install --ask-become-pass
```
Finally add `refresh_token`, `client_id` and `client_secret` to each cluster in `clusters.yaml`.
